title: Axolotl Recipe Book &  Totem
description: "A simple resource pack that replaces the recipe book and the totem of undying with axolotls. Cute and fun for axolotl lovers
body:
---

📖 Axolotl Recipe Book & Totem

This simple resource pack changes:

The recipe book icon into an axolotl 🦎

The totem of undying into an axolotl 🪄

Bring some extra cuteness into Minecraft — axolotls will now follow you both in the UI and in battle!

✅ Works with all versions that include axolotls and the totem of undying.
🎨 Lightweight and minimal, with no unnecessary changes.


---
